text_simplified: The text speaks of the importance of tarbiyah (nurturing) of children upon Islamic values and noble akhlaq (character). It points to the necessity of teaching them truthfulness, amanah (trustworthiness), and keeping away from bad behaviors. It also clarifies the role of parents in guiding their children toward righteousness and avoiding bad companions. It emphasizes that tarbiyah of children upon the religion and akhlaq is a great responsibility that rests upon the family.
